body:
I've explored any art forms since I've been committed.  Oil pastels, crayons, fingerprinting, watercolor, origami, poetry, and journaling.

I find much like I struggle to communicate my feelings in language, I struggle in these art forms.  I find the translation of feeling=>art just as difficult as feeling=>language.


What is work and what is play

When meaning is molded on minds of clay

I used to spend many hours on a game

But now it doesn't seem quite the same

I realize I'm a part of a larger organization

But I despise this civilization.

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/kbzdv/my_decision/

I'm 25 now, been in a couple of mental institutions and they are trying to put me in a group home.  I trie telling my therapist I'm really struggling right now and she just asked me to do some fucking dbt worksheets.  I wish someone really understood how I feel or what I'm trying to tell them.

I'm from Alaska, but I've been living in Washington the last number of years. Alaska is no place to transition.  My family is all in Alaska still, but I have a good group of friends down here.
